PLANNING COMMISSION AGENDA

Thursday, November 19, 2026, 6:30 PM

1020 East Pioneer Road

Draper, UT 84020

Council Chambers

6:30 PM BUSINESS MEETING

1.	Items for Commission Consideration

1.a Public Hearing: Wadsworth Exchange 4 Story Site Plan Request (Administrative Action)

On the request of Joshua Workman, representing Architectural Nexus, Inc. for a Site Plan on 2.15 acres of property located at approximately 14068 South 145 East in the CR (Regional Commercial) zone. Known as application 2026-0237-SP. Staff contact: Jennifer Jastremsky, 801-576-6328, jennifer.jastremsky@draperutah.gov.

2.	Other Business

2.a Coordination between City Staff and Planning Commission (as needed)

3.	Adjournment

I, the City Recorder of Draper City, certify that copies of this agenda for the Draper Planning Commission meeting to be held on November 19, 2026, were posted at Draper City Hall, the Draper City website www.draperutah.gov, and the Utah Public Notice website at www.utah.gov/pmn.


Nicole Smedley, CMC, City Recorder, Draper City, State of Utah

Posted on October 29, 2026 on the Utah Public Notice Website www.utah.gov/pmn/ Draper City Website www.draperutah.gov/news/ and at Draper City Hall, 1020 E. Pioneer Road, Draper, UT

NOTICE OF PUBLIC HEARING: 12430 S. 700 East Zoning Map Amendment and Development Agreement Requests

Notice is hereby given that Draper City will hold a public hearing before the Planning Commission to consider the above listed request.  The property is located at approximately 12430 S. 700 East.  The purpose of the request is for a: 1) rezone from RA1 (Residential Agricultural, 40,000 sq. ft. minimum) and RA2 (Residential Agricultural, 20,000 sq. ft. minimum) to R4 (Single Family Residential, 10,000 sq. ft. minimum), and 2) development agreement to allow the property to develop with specific setback, landscaping and fencing standards in conjunction with a rezoning application.

The hearing will be held at Draper City Hall in the City Council Chambers on November 12, 2026, at 6:30 p.m.  The complete notice is posted on the Utah Public Notice Website; www.utah.gov/pmn/, Draper City Website; www.draperutah.gov/news/, and at Draper City Hall. 

To request a copy of the public notice or for additional inquiries contact Maryann DeHaven at (801) 576-6391 or maryann.dehaven@draperutah.gov.

Dated this 29th Day of October, 2026

Attest: Nicole Smedley, City Recorder

Posted on October 29, 2026 on the Utah Public Notice Website www.utah.gov/pmn/ Draper City Website www.draperutah.gov/news/ and at Draper City Hall, 1020 E. Pioneer Road, Draper, UT

NOTICE OF PUBLIC HEARING: Concord Farm Lane Zoning Map, Land Use Map and Development Agreement Amendment Requests

Notice is hereby given that Draper City will hold a public hearing before the Planning Commission to consider the above listed requests.  The property is located at approximately 13720 S. 300 East.  The purpose of the request is for a: 1) a Zoning Map Amendment from the RA1 (Residential Agricultural, 40,000 square foot lot minimum) to the RM1 (Multi-family Residential, up to 8 dwelling units per acre), 2) a Land Use Map Amendment from the Residential Low/Medium Density designation to the Residential Medium/High Density designation, and 3) a Development Agreement Amendment to incorporate the four proposed lots into the existing Concord Farm Lane subdivision.

The hearing will be held at Draper City Hall in the City Council Chambers on November 12, 2026, at 6:30 p.m.  The complete notice is posted on the Utah Public Notice Website; www.utah.gov/pmn/, Draper City Website; www.draperutah.gov/news/, and at Draper City Hall.
